dedupe_keys.name: generalitat de catalunya wildfire hazard datasets

description: Generalitat de Catalunya: wildfire hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Generalitat de Catalunya. Coverage: Generalitat de Catalunya. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wildfire hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Entidades colaboradoras de la Administración en el ámbito de la preven; Personal técnico de las entidades colaboradoras de la Administración e. Formats seen: CSV, JSON, XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://administraciodigital.gencat.cat/ca/dades/dades-obertes/informacio-practica/llicencies/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
